summary: Murcia's first-party municipal geovisor, Geoportal, and SITAM parcel-layer metadata were evidenced, but no safe native parcel geometry response was verified. No sample GeoJSON was retained.
queryOutcomes: English and Spanish discovery queries are recorded verbatim in city-4312-murcia.json under freshResearch.queries. Results were limited to official municipal viewer/Geoportal, SITAM layer metadata, and national Catastro documentation.
requestOutcomes: Executed first-party HTML, metadata, bounded ArcGIS query, and documented WMS probes are recorded under requestsAndEndpointChecks. The exact WUP-point ArcGIS query returned an empty GeoJSON FeatureCollection; the legacy WMS probes returned HTTP 400. No login, CAPTCHA bypass, credentials, private token, unsafe field, or TLS exception was used.
scopeLimits: The SITAM layer is named public parcels; its citywide completeness and whether it is cadastral, municipal-inventory, or public-property coverage are not established beyond the published layer metadata.
The municipal viewer advertises GeoJSON export and cadastral-reference search, but no bounded safe parcel response was obtained from the UI route in this attempt.
The exact WUP-point query was empty and is only a point-query miss, not evidence of citywide parcel absence.
The national Catastro WMS documentation is general agency evidence and was not treated as a Murcia local registry integration.
The legacy WMS HTTP 400 and viewer inspection limitation are request/UI limitations, not evidence of citywide absence.

geometryRetention.reason: No safe, verified native parcel geometry response was available.

uncertainty: Open parcel coverage, native identity semantics, geometry quality, and citywide completeness remain unverified. Municipal registry/map custody is documented, but runtime integration is not admitted.
